clue.text: Ancient weapon

definitions.meaning: The swaggering ensign (an 'ancient') among Falstaff's cronies in Shakespeare

explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's character holds the rank of ancient, an old word for ensign, and the same name is a handgun.

clue.text: Impractical scheme trimmed paper

parts.note: piped means decorated with piping, a trim on clothes or cakes
a ream is 500 sheets of paper

explanation.surface: An unworkable plan for cutting down some paper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trimmed' suggests cut, but it means edged with piping.
explanation.definitionFit: A fantasy that will never come true, from opium-smoking visions.

clue.text: It's found on the beach in an English resort

definitions.text: It's found on the beach in an English resort

parts.words: It's found on the beach in an English resort
parts.note: describes the pebbly cover of many English seaside beaches, such as Brighton's

explanation.definitionFit: Many English seaside beaches are covered with small rounded pebbles rather than sand.

clue.text: Frequently multiplied by decimal first

indicators.note: first says the pieces from by and decimal come ahead of the piece for multiplied

parts.note: by and of are interchangeable, as in a play of or by Shakespeare
decimal counting is based on ten
times is the word for multiplied, as in two times three

explanation.surface: A sum where you multiply by ten before anything else, again and again.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic word for often, meaning on many occasions.

clue.text: Part of arrow I preserve in Tower of London

parts.note: the barb is the backward-pointing tip of an arrowhead
to can food is to preserve it

explanation.surface: A fragment of an arrow is kept on display at the Tower of London.
explanation.walkthrough: A barbican is a fortified gate-tower, and the Barbican is also a district of the City of London, so the definition works both ways.
explanation.definitionFit: A barbican is a defensive outwork or gatehouse tower, and London has a district of that name.

clue.text: High-flier's exceptional achievement on course

definitions.meaning: a large seabird that soars for long distances
in golf, a hole completed three strokes under par

explanation.definitionFit: The great wandering seabird and the golfing term for three under par on one hole.

clue.text: Edict from Pope John representing us

definitions.meaning: John ... is the personification of England or Britain

explanation.definitionFit: A papal decree, and the surname of John, the cartoon figure standing for the English people.

clue.text: Chance I might crash into this obstacle on course?

indicators.note: might crash suggests the letters collide and end up scrambled

explanation.surface: A driver may crash into this barrier on the track by bad luck.
explanation.definitionFit: A tight S-bend placed on a motor-racing circuit to slow cars down.

clue.text: Character in Dickens' story set in London and French city

definitions.text: Character in Dickens' story set in London
definitions.meaning: Bill Sikes's girl in Oliver Twist
the capital of Lorraine in north-eastern France

explanation.definitionFit: The doomed girl in Oliver Twist and the city in Lorraine share a name.

clue.text: Live over a railhead in Paddington, say

indicators.note: over in a down clue means the first piece sits above, so before, the rest

parts.note: to be is to exist or live
the head of rail is its first letter

explanation.surface: Living above a railway terminus at Paddington station.
explanation.walkthrough: Paddington is both a London station and the famous storybook bear from Peru.
explanation.definitionFit: Paddington is the marmalade-loving storybook animal, an example of the species.

clue.text: Make pure liquid, say, into exciting drink

indicators.note: say tells us the word for cleaning a liquid is to be spoken, giving one spelt differently

parts.note: to filter a liquid is to strain it clean

explanation.surface: Strain a liquid clean and turn it into a stimulating beverage.
explanation.definitionFit: A love potion is meant to arouse passion, so it is a stimulating brew.

clue.text: Bengali translated into another language

indicators.note: translated suggests the letters of the clue word are converted into a different form

explanation.surface: A Bengali text is rendered into some other tongue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'translated' fits the language surface but is the anagram signal; the definition is loose, since Belgians speak French, Dutch or German.
explanation.definitionFit: Loosely, the speech of Belgium, treated by the setter as a tongue distinct from Bengali.

clue.text: Greek character broke promise, backing corrupt type

indicators.note: backing means the two pieces before it, taken together, are read from end to start

parts.note: eta is the seventh letter of the Greek alphabet
to renege is to go back on a promise

explanation.surface: A Greek fellow went back on his word and supported a crooked person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' turns the whole run ETARENEGED round.
explanation.definitionFit: A degenerate is a person sunk into moral decay, a debased sort.

clue.text: Initially reserved in manner?

indicators.note: in tells us the opening letter is placed inside the word for manner

parts.note: a way of doing something is its manner

indicators.note: Initially picks out the opening letter of the word reserved

explanation.surface: Someone holding back from the start in how they behave.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also describes the answer: a cautious person is reserved in manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Being cautious and guarded is being reserved in one's behaviour.

clue.text: Fabulous entrée, so to speak

parts.note: a spoken password giving entry in a fable, the magic words in Ali Baba

explanation.definitionFit: The magic command that opened the robbers' cave in the Arabian Nights tale, words that grant entry.

clue.text: Making uniform of a relatively late period

definitions.meaning: levelling out, making smooth or equal
the latter part of the day

explanation.definitionFit: Levelling a surface flat is one sense; the other is the part of the day after afternoon.

clue.text: Plant something better than silver " birch?

parts.note: gold ranks above silver, so golden
a birch is a rod for flogging

explanation.surface: A botanist wonders whether a tree beats the silver birch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'birch' looks like the tree, but it is the cane once used for punishment.
explanation.definitionFit: A tall yellow-flowered perennial of the daisy family.

clue.text: Musical genius re-designed even parts of opera house

indicators.note: re-designed says the collected letters are rearranged into a new layout
even parts of takes the second and fourth letters of the word opera

explanation.surface: An architect remodels sections of a theatre built for opera.
explanation.walkthrough: 'even parts of' applies only to 'opera', giving PR; with HOUSE that is PRHOUSE, which 're-designed' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth the lyre-player could charm beasts and stones with his music, the archetype of musical brilliance.

clue.text: Material for piano, perhaps, demonstrated to conductor

parts.note: to protest by occupying a place is to sit in, so sat in
Sir Henry Wood was the conductor who founded the Proms

explanation.surface: A pianist performed for a conductor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'piano' is the object made of the material, not music.
explanation.definitionFit: A fine lustrous timber used in cabinetry and instrument cases.

clue.text: Be amazed by line a poet produced

indicators.note: by here means placed beside, so the second piece follows the first

parts.note: to marvel is to be filled with wonder

explanation.surface: Someone is astounded at a line a poet has written.
explanation.walkthrough: Andrew Marvell was a 17th-century English poet ('To His Coy Mistress').
explanation.definitionFit: Andrew Marvell was a metaphysical writer of verse, an example of the class.

clue.text: Boats get burnt crossing it

parts.note: combines two idioms for an irrevocable step: burning one's boats and crossing a famous river

explanation.definitionFit: Caesar's crossing of this Italian river was a point of no return, like burning one's boats.

clue.text: Part of star's appearance making newspapers a lot of money

parts.note: The Sun is a British tabloid, so several copies are Suns
a pot is a large sum, as in a pot of money

explanation.surface: A celebrity's public appearances bring the papers a fortune.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'star' is literally our Sun, not a celebrity.
explanation.definitionFit: A dark patch on the solar surface is a feature of how that star looks.

clue.text: For a place of worship, it's anti-religious

parts.note: pro means in favour of
a fane is an old word for a temple

explanation.surface: Something in favour of a church is somehow against religion.
explanation.definitionFit: Irreverent or blasphemous, showing contempt for the sacred.

clue.text: Sailor taken in by sweetheart

indicators.note: taken in tells us one piece is held inside the word that follows

parts.note: AB, able-bodied seaman, is a standard abbreviation for a sailor

explanation.surface: A seaman is fooled by his lover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' is not a link: it supplies the outer letters, with AB inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Baby is a term of endearment for a loved one.

clue.text: Iron extracted from shorter pipe

indicators.note: extracted from signals that the iron symbol is pulled out of the next word

parts.note: briefer means shorter
Fe is the chemical symbol for iron

explanation.surface: Metal pulled out of a stubby smoking pipe.
explanation.definitionFit: Briar root is the wood for tobacco pipes, so the name stands for the pipe itself.

clue.text: Smooth ruffled feathers?

parts.note: read literally, flattening a bird's soft plumage; idiomatically, calming an agitated person

explanation.definitionFit: Becoming calm after agitation, pictured as soothing a bird's disturbed plumage, since soft feathers are down.

clue.text: Shandy in a mug

definitions.meaning: Uncle ... is a character in Sterne's Tristram Shandy
a drinking mug shaped like a seated man

explanation.definitionFit: Uncle Toby of Sterne's novel bears the surname, and a figure-shaped jug carries the name.

clue.text: 'e's abandoning a prophet for another one

indicators.note: abandoning means the letters spelled out leave the preceding phrase

parts.note: Moses is the Old Testament prophet
the clue spells out the letters E and S

explanation.surface: A man leaves one prophet for a different one.
explanation.definitionFit: Amos is a minor Old Testament prophet, a different seer from Moses.

clue.text: Money made by king's successor

indicators.note: by here means set alongside, so the next piece comes after

parts.note: income is the money one earns
R, for rex, is the Latin abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: Wealth earned by the heir to a monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: A newcomer who arrives to take over a role or place follows on after another.

clue.text: Show of courage, taking little notice when trapped by killer

indicators.note: when trapped by tells us the short piece sits inside the word for killer

parts.note: a bravo is a hired assassin or thug
an ad is a small advertisement or notice

explanation.surface: Bold display from someone who paid scant attention when cornered by a murderer.
explanation.walkthrough: BRAVO as a hired killer is an old sense worth knowing.
explanation.definitionFit: Bravado is a swaggering display of boldness, often a mask for fear.

clue.text: Residing, unfortunately, in close vicinity to fighting

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests the letters of the clue word have gone badly wrong and are jumbled

explanation.surface: Sadly someone lives right next to where the brawling happens.
explanation.definitionFit: Ringside seats are those beside the boxing ring, closest to the bout.

clue.text: Observed to undergo arrest

definitions.meaning: to be taken into custody, read as two words

explanation.definitionFit: Saw is the past-tense sense; split into two words it means be detained by police.
